question: Isolated fixed-proper-volume thermal-feedback reversible H/D CX; reuse actual Savin rates, one extent and one thermal/binding ledger.

inputs.provider: immutable rate callable(T)->(kf,kr), named source and inclusive Tmin/Tmax
inputs.initial_temperature: derived from thermal density, never supplied as a second independent state

algorithm.name: adaptive Heun SSP-RK2 with step doubling
algorithm.step: e=z+h*G(z); v=e+h*G(e); H=(z+v)/2; interval-check e,v; field checks actual density/T inputs
algorithm.initial_step: t_requested/16 unless zero; no imposed minimum physical time
algorithm.error_reject: same cubic factor capped<=0.8; invalid-domain stages halve h
algorithm.event: accepted-state outward-toward-provider-boundary and normalized distance<=event_atol -> partial DOMAIN_BOUNDARY_APPROACH, no clamp
algorithm.equilibrium: exact G==0 -> COMPLETE_EQUILIBRIUM at requested time with unchanged state; do not infer equilibrium from small G
algorithm.degenerate: Validate finite nonnegative densities, thermal and time, a finite signed defect, and finite ordered positive provider-temperature metadata first. S==0 and thermal==0 -> COMPLETE_EMPTY, t_reached=t_requested, T=null, amplitude=null, no RHS; S==0 and thermal>0 invalid. Otherwise derive/validate T and interval even for t_requested==0; then dt0 -> COMPLETE unchanged with zero RHS. For positive time exact G==0 -> COMPLETE_EQUILIBRIUM at requested time. D=0 follows exact zero field, not invented temperature.
algorithm.underflow: if h<=0 or t+h==t -> STEP_UNDERFLOW partial
algorithm.error_meaning: local heuristic only; no certified global bound or stiffness guarantee
algorithm.failures: Invalid initial values/metadata/outside-domain T -> INVALID_INPUT. Every attempted RHS evaluation charged first; provider exception, nonfinite or negative returned rate, or nonfinite valid-domain arithmetic -> ARITHMETIC_FAILURE at last accepted state. Euler-stage interval violations reject/halve; do not call provider there.

requirements: last accepted state retained on incomplete results
no rate extrapolation or negativity clipping
every RHS evaluation charged including failure
Savin formulas retain source coefficients and inclusive domain
completed input identity validated once; do not replay old suites

verification.manufactured: new cases in FIXTURES; normalized endpoint error <=5e-6 for ordinary default integrations; exact oracle carries its own status
verification.refinement: same manufactured smooth case fixed Heun N16/32/64, each error decreases; observed ratios between3.0 and5.0 for both successive refinements, unless reviewer identifies cancellation and authorizes one fixture repair
verification.ledger: max absolute invariant residual <=128*machine_epsilon*max(1,gross appropriate quantities); energy cancellation normalized by max(1e-30,abs(u0),abs(delta_chi*xi)); use128eps multiplier
verification.savin: two declared tiny trajectories + near-lower-domain case; finite nonnegative state, ledger/domain checks; default/tighter pair differences recorded, not true error
verification.event: manufactured analytic crossing fixture: partial status, t_reached<t_requested, within event_atol normalized of correct boundary, no domain-violating provider evaluation; time difference to analytic crossing recorded without certification
verification.budget: forced max_attempts=1 test yields incomplete WORK_LIMIT and last accepted state
verification.conversion: one equivalent physical initial state/rate through SI-to-unit conversion verifies same G up to128eps scaling; no old Rust run

publication: stage_delivery immutable capture before each stage; only newunit files; stage commits/backups owned by publisher
claim_ceiling: Standalone isolated thermal-CX mathematical reduction and scoped tested numerical implementation. No full-network/isotope/cosmological admission.

review_repair.finding: R6 signed-defect validation wording inconsistent with theory
review_repair.replacement: finite signed defect; nonnegative applies only to density/thermal/time
review_repair.affected: input validation and negative-defect thermal interval ordering; physics/model unchanged
review_repair.added_fixture: negative_defect beta=-0.1; generic signed oracle identity reusable
